look: a female sahuagin, a stocky fish-folk with deep teal scaled skin, a smooth domed head with a blunt snout, ribbed fin ears, webbed clawed hands, a fin under each forearm and one tall back fin
torso_tilt: first the top plane of the chest with its two pectoral muscles meeting at the breastbone, then, tucked under the chest, a short glimpse of the flat upper belly.
torso_paint: the torso as one athletic chest with two pectoral muscles and a flat upper belly below them

back_fin.label: over_garment
back_fin.guide: One tall fin stands on the middle of the upper back behind the head, a narrow blade that tapers to a point at the top of the picture.
back_fin.paint: the back fin as one smooth ribbed blade

arm_fin_l.label: forearm_l
arm_fin_l.guide: A small flat fin hangs from the lower edge of each forearm near the elbow.
arm_fin_l.paint: each forearm fin as a thin ribbed membrane

feet_tilt: At the very bottom the front halves of the two feet stand on the floor far below, toes pointing at the bottom of the picture, each a broad webbed foot front with four toes that fan out and end in claws.
feet_paint: each foot front with four webbed toes ending in short dark claws
hands_paint: each hand with five webbed fingers ending in small dark claws
arms_paint: the shoulder band and the level arms as smooth teal skin over firm muscle with a few patches of rounded paler scales
